task: T20 exact-master browser regression synchronization repair
evidence_directory_name_note: Opaque run identifier only; it does not attest the actual start time. Command times below are UTC.

controlled_race_evidence.method: Playwright holds the exact POST /api/projects/{project.id}/plans request before forwarding it to the local API. While held, the browser navigates to Plans & review and a direct query of the test-owned PostgreSQL database asserts exactly two project plans. The route is then released; the test requires the exact POST response to return 201, the ensuing exact project-detail GET refresh to return 200, the refresh control to re-enable, and the returned plan row to render before taking the existing three-plan snapshot.
controlled_race_evidence.conclusion: The fixture has a deterministic timing race when it snapshots PostgreSQL immediately after starting the asynchronous browser mutation. This controlled gate demonstrates that the plan is absent until the request completes.
controlled_race_evidence.limitation: The original master CI failure has no HTTP timing capture. This local controlled-gate result proves the test race is possible; it does not establish that the same timing was the exact cause of the original CI failure, which remains retained as FAIL.

environment.database_isolation: Each browser test uses openIsolatedProductDatabase to create and drop its own test database.
